events.title: Studies in Light Light, Shadow & Atmosphere
events.description:
Paint from a still-life reference with step-by-step guidance. Explore light, shadow, and how to capture different materials, including glass and metal.In this welcoming oil painting workshop, artist Kristina Dubrovskaia will guide you through a still-life study, exploring how warm highlights, cool shadows, and subtle color shifts create depth and atmosphere.
You’ll learn to simplify what you see, mix colors thoughtfully, and build form with expressive brushstrokes. We’ll focus on capturing the feeling of light without getting lost in tiny details, leaving room for your own interpretation.
Whether you’re trying oils for the first time or returning to painting, you’ll receive step-by-step guidance in a relaxed, supportive setting.
Spend a Saturday morning slowing down, looking closely, and enjoying the process of painting.
All materials provided
Reserve your spot and explore painting with us.
events.vendor: Studies in Light Light, Shadow & Atmosphere

events.title: Industry City Gourmet Food and Drinks Tour
events.description:
Set against the iconic backdrop of Sunset Park’s historic waterfront, the massive, revitalized structures of Industry City form a breathtaking stage for an exclusive culinary journey. This premium food and cocktail tour is a curated exploration of taste and craft, transforming an evening into a memorable, high-end experience.
Your adventure begins with artistic bonbons at Lilac Chocolates, explores gourmet imports at Sahadi’s, and includes a refined whiskey tasting at Fort Hamilton Distillery, followed by a sophisticated sake flight. Savor additional artisanal discoveries within the awe-inspiring industrial halls.
Perfect as a distinctive date night, this tour is also fully customizable for private groups and corporate retreats. We specialize in tailoring this engaging experience for team-building and client entertainment, making it an ideal one-day corporate outing. A sophisticated mini-vacation for locals and a profound discovery for visitors.

events.title: Shiatsu & Chair Makko Ho Class
events.description:
Discover the art of Japanese wellness through Shiatsu and Chair Makko Ho, guided by Kumiko Kanayama, Founder and Director of Five Lights Center of Shiatsu.
Shiatsu is a Japanese bodywork practice that uses gentle pressure applied to specific points on the body to promote relaxation and support overall well-being. Chair Makko Ho is a series of simple stretches designed to improve flexibility, encourage mindful breathing, and help you connect with your body.
Everything will be done seated, and no additional equipment is needed. Just come ready to stretch, breathe, and unwind! Whether you’re new to Japanese wellness practices or looking to deepen your experience, everyone is welcome.
events.vendor: Shiatsu & Chair Makko Ho Class

events.title: Turkish Wine Tasting at Sahadi Spirits!
events.description:
Yavuz from the family will be pouring a lineup from his family’s certified organic vineyard, Selendi wines!
“Certified Organic farming methods and an utmost respect for the land itself create the foundation of our vineyard.
We meticulously practice the finer points of organic farming, meaning no pesticides or chemical intervention of any kind in our process. Each vine is carefully and naturally tended to from seed to grape production, nurtured pruned by the people who live and work on the land.
Naturally farming and harvesting our grapes not only produces a superior product, but also allows us to protect our biggest asset- the land itself. We are very sensitive to this philosophy and method, garnering a certificate from the French Ecocert company. We are regularly inspected and reviewed for these organic practices.
events.vendor: Turkish Wine Tasting at Sahadi Spirits!
